newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Kalamazoo half yr profit and div rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Kalamazoo half yr profit and div rise.

text.p: Building materials and office supplies group Kalamazoo Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday that it achieved a sharp rise in first half operating profit which was due to the inclusion of the Arlex and Newhaven electrical products units.
The company said pre-tax operating profit in the six months ended December 31 rose 84.3 percent to A$12.02 million and net profit soared by 117 percent to A$9.21 million.
The fully franked first half dividend was increased to eight cents from six cents a year ago.

"The increase in EBITA (earnings before interest, tax and amortisation) is due to the inclusion of Arlec and Newhaven for the full six months in the current period and earnings growth in these businesses," it said.

"Directors believe that provided there is a continuation of the current economic and trading conditions, KLZ's EBITA in the second half should exceed the A$12 million EBITA achieved in the first half.

"The outlook for the full year to 30 June 1997 is for a substantial increase in both the EBITA of A$15.5 million and the operating profit after tax of A$11.8 million achieved in the year to 30 June 1996," the company said.
